port.description: TCP port for MPD client connections.

bind_address.description: Network interface to bind MPD to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for local-only, or 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

use_socket.description: Enable Unix socket for local client connections (overrides TCP port if enabled).

socket_path.description: Path to the Unix socket file (used only if use_socket is true).

paths.description: Core filesystem paths for MPD databases, logs, music, and state files.

audio_outputs.description: List of audio output devices (e.g., ALSA, PipeWire, PulseAudio). Each item configures one output.

name.description: Human-readable name of the output (shown in clients).

device.description: Device name or identifier (e.g., hw:0,0 for ALSA card 0 device 0).

format.description: Output sample format as `sample_rate:bits:channels` (e.g., 48000:24:2 for 48kHz, 24-bit, stereo). Use 'auto' to inherit from source.

dmix.description: Enable dmix (shared hardware mixing) for ALSA. Set to 'off' for exclusive access.

samplerate_converter.description: Resampling algorithm quality (higher = better quality, more CPU).

autosuspend.description: Automatically suspend audio device when idle (PulseAudio/PipeWire only).

buffer_time.description: Audio buffer time in microseconds (500,000 = 0.5s). Increase to reduce dropouts on slow systems.

audio_format.description: Global output sample format override (e.g., '44100:24:2'). Leave empty to use input source format.

resample_quality.description: Legacy resampling quality (0–7). Prefer `samplerate_converter` in output blocks for newer MPD.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneously connected clients.

max_players.description: Maximum number of concurrent playback streams (e.g., for multiroom setups).

max_readers.description: Maximum number of parallel file reads (improves performance with large libraries).

max_buffer_size.description: Maximum internal buffer size in kilobytes (~0.5 MB). Increase for high-bitrate streaming.

filesystem_charset.description: Character set for filesystem paths (should almost always be 'UTF-8').

filesystem_iconv.description: Enable iconv-based charset conversion for legacy filesystems (e.g., 'yes', 'no').

follow_symlink.description: Follow symlinks inside the music directory.

follow_outside_symlink.description: Follow symlinks pointing outside the music directory.

user.description: User account to run MPD under (use 'root' only for testing; not recommended).

group.description: Group for file permissions (e.g., 'audio' to allow audio device access).

log_level.description: Verbosity of log output. Use 'debug' only for troubleshooting.

sticker_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for sticker database queries.

randomize_playlist.description: Randomize playback order by default in playlists.

crossfade.description: Crossfade duration in seconds (0 disables crossfading).

replay_gain_mode.description: Replay Gain processing mode. 'auto' applies track/album gain as needed.

replay_gain_preamp.description: Additional preamp (in dB) applied to Replay Gain (e.g., +5.0 to boost volume).

replay_gain_fallback.description: Gain (in dB) applied if no metadata is present (e.g., -10.0 to avoid clipping).

restore_volume.description: Restore last volume setting on startup.

audio_delay.description: Audio delay in milliseconds (useful for lip-sync correction).

audio_buffer_size.description: Audio buffer size in kilobytes (legacy; prefer `buffer_time` in audio_output blocks).

network_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for network I/O (e.g., streaming).

network_buffer.description: Network buffer size in milliseconds (0 = disable buffering).

zeroconf_enabled.description: Enable Zeroconf/Avahi service discovery for MPD (allows auto-discovery on LAN).

zeroconf_name.description: Service name advertised via Zeroconf (shown in discovery clients).

quality.description: Encoder quality (0.0–1.0; higher = better quality, larger bandwidth).

tag_types.description: Priority order of metadata tag formats to read (left to right).

gapless_mp3.description: Enable gapless playback for MP3 files (requires precise Xing headers).

buffer_fill_time.description: Buffer fill time in milliseconds (used to avoid underruns on startup).
